additions.name: Call Kolyarut
additions.summary: A kolyarut performs one duty for you.

additions.name: Claws of Darkness
additions.summary: Claws deal 1d8 cold damage and have reach.

additions.name: Flame Whips
additions.summary: Your forelimbs deal 6d6 fire damage.

additions.name: Forceward
additions.summary: Creates a sphere of force that protects against force effects and keeps out incorporeal creatures.

additions.name: Giant's Wrath
additions.summary: Pebbles you throw become boulders.

additions.name: Glass Strike
additions.target: One creature or 4 cubic ft. of material
additions.summary: Turns subject into glass.

additions.name: Glowing Orb
additions.summary: Creates permanent magical light; you control brightness.

additions.name: Light of Venya
additions.summary: You radiate pearly light, which you can expend as 2 bolts that deal 2d6 damage, 4d6 against undead and evil outsiders.

additions.name: Nerveskitter
additions.summary: Subject gains +5 bonus on initiative checks.

additions.name: Net of Shadows
additions.target: One creature/level, no two of which are more than 25 ft. apart
additions.summary: Ordinary shadows that provide concealment to all in the area.

additions.name: Nightshield
additions.summary: You gain resistance bonus on saves, and spell absorbs magic missile damage.

additions.name: Obedient Avalanche
additions.effect: 20-ft.-radius avalanche of snow centered on a point in space; see text
additions.savingThrow: Reflex half or Reflex negates; see text
additions.summary: Snowy avalanche crushes and buries your foes.

additions.name: Opalescent Glare
additions.summary: Kill creatures with a look, or make them very afraid.

additions.name: Perinarch
additions.savingThrow: None (object) and Reflex negates; see text
additions.summary: Gain greater control over Limbo's morphic essence.

additions.name: Perinarch, Planar
additions.summary: Gain control over a small area of any divinely morphic plane.

additions.name: Persistent Blade
additions.summary: Blade of force attacks subject, automatically flanks.

additions.name: Phantom Foe
additions.summary: Subject is always flanked by one creature.

additions.name: Planar Bubble
additions.summary: Create bubble around creature that emulates its native planar environment.

additions.summary: You are alerted when a creature passes through a warded portal.

additions.name: Portal Alarm, Improved
additions.summary: Warded portal alerts you or a creature designated by you to creatures passing through it.

additions.name: Quick Potion
additions.summary: Creates a potion that must be used within 1 hour/level.

additions.summary: 1d6 damage/level, victims dazed or dazzled.

additions.summary: Fires burn twice as hot, half as long.

additions.summary: Line deals 1d6 damage of each energy type.

additions.summary: Ray deals 1d6 damage/level to constructs.

additions.summary: Ray attacks are reflected away.

additions.name: Ray of Dizziness

additions.summary: Ray deals 1d6 cold damage/2 levels.

additions.summary: Ray blinds subject.

additions.summary: Subject becomes sickened.

additions.summary: Victim takes 1d4+1 Intelligence damage.

additions.summary: Subject takes –2 on attacks, –10 ft. speed.

additions.savingThrow: Will negates, Reflex negates; see text

additions.summary: Viewers see you as their own species and gender.

additions.target: One creature/2 levels, no two of which are more than 30 ft. apart
additions.summary: Viewers see subjects as their own species and gender.

additions.summary: Duplicate observed spell or spell-like ability.

additions.summary: As protection from arrows, but negated arrows turn back upon their source.

additions.name: Ruby Ray of Reversal
additions.target: One natural or magical hazard; see text
